evidence_items.value: Multiple UNC93B1 mutations (G325C, D34A, E92G) described to enhance TLR7 function; none enhanced binding but rather affected signaling termination

raw_source.text_snippet: However, none of these mutations enhanced binding to TLR7 but instead often decreased the mechanisms that terminate TLR7 signaling (19, 20, 24, 25). Of note, the E92G mutation in UNC93B1, which increases TLR7 responses, was shown to decrease UNC93B1 binding to TLR7 but also affects termination of TLR7 signaling by decreasing synthenin1 recruitment (24, 26).
